name: type-morph
title: Type Morph
description: A headline that types itself under a glowing caret, sheds its lead, morphs letter by letter, and ends under a colour flood.
docs: Docs and props: https://snapcn.dev/docs/text/type-morph?ref=cli — pass mode="dark" if you are rendering onto a dark frame — these default to shadcn's light palette and a bare Remotion render is black.
